modules.title: 一份准备合并的改动怎样自动得到检查
CI 在合并改动前做什么

items.title: 每次改动都尽早检查
items.text: 单独看似正常的改动，放进项目现有代码和设置后也可能出错。每当有人提交或申请合并时，CI 就自动检查页面能否生成、关键功能有没有出错，让问题离这次改动更近。

items.title: 结果要能帮助决定下一步
items.text: 检查结果要对应这份改动，并清楚显示是否通过和失败原因。这样一旦失败，团队知道先修再合；通过后再决定要不要发布到测试地址。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: CI 不等于某个工具，也不等于自动上线。它的重点是每次改动都要自动和现有项目一起检查；检查通过后，是否发到可访问的地址是另一个步骤。

lessonPractice.title: 有人说“我们有 CI”，但团队每周五才手动把所有分支合起来跑一次测试。这个判断对吗？

options.label: 不算完整的 CI；测试没有跟着每次改动自动运行
options.feedback: 对。CI 的价值在于每次变更靠近共享主线时自动验证，而不是攒到最后。

options.label: 算 CI；只要合并前完整跑过一次测试就可以
options.feedback: 是否自动、持续地围绕变更运行，决定了它是否发挥持续集成作用。

options.label: 不算 CI；因为检查通过后还没有自动发布到生产
options.feedback: 自动发布属于 CD 的范围，CI 本身重点是构建和验证。

en.title: A team says it has CI, but only manually combines all branches and tests on Fridays. Is that right?

options.label: Not complete CI; tests do not run automatically with each change
options.feedback: Correct. CI gains value by automatic verification as each change approaches the shared line, not at the end.

options.label: It is CI; one full test run before merging is enough
options.feedback: Whether it runs automatically and continuously around changes determines whether it serves continuous integration.

options.label: It is not CI because passing checks do not automatically deploy to production
options.feedback: Automatic release belongs to CD; CI itself focuses on build and verification.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让每次 PR 自动运行 Lint、构建和关键测试，并把结果关联到具体 PR。任何检查失败都不要允许合并；通过后给出对应提交、检查名称和结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make every PR automatically run lint, build, and critical tests, with results attached to that PR. Do not allow merge when any check fails; after passing, provide the commit, check names, and results.

learning.assumes: You know several people’s changes eventually meet in shared code.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a submission receives automatic, visible checks and use them for a merge decision.

modules.title: How a PR receives automatic pre-merge checks
What CI does before shared code

items.title: Find combination problems with each change
items.text: A change that seems fine alone can fail with mainline code, dependencies, or configuration. CI repeats build and tests on a push or PR, keeping failures close to their originating commit.

items.title: Make results actionable
items.text: Checks should attach to a commit or PR and clearly show success, failure, and logs. The team can then block an unpassed merge or continue a passing version to testing.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: CI is not one particular GitHub Actions file and not automatic production release. Its core is continuously integrating and automatically verifying changes; CD then handles how passing versions remain releasable or reach production.

distinctions.label: CD
distinctions.text: {c:ci} automatically builds and tests changes as they enter a shared mainline. {c:cd} continues moving validated versions toward a releasable or released state.
